title: US Treasury yields ease after CPI, but Fed hike risks linger
summary: US Treasury yields fall during the North American session following the release of US inflation data, but are poised to finish the week higher. The US 10-year Treasury yield is down 1 basis point to 4.951% but has gained over 16 basis points, or 3.49%, in the week.
